t.zh: 只接 issue 的板，在这里会编出不存在的函数：代码不在模型的上下文里。模型只有一个输入口，两样东西要先并成一段。
t.en: A board wired with the issue alone makes up functions here: the code is not in the model’s context. The model has one input, so the two have to become one context first.

after.zh: 拼接把几段上下文按顺序接成一段。现在由你决定模型看到什么、按什么顺序看到。
after.en: Concat joins contexts into one, in order. Now you decide what the model sees, and in what order.

brief.zh: 这次 issue 没贴代码，代码单独给在左边。让模型两样都看到。
brief.en: This time the issue has no code; the code comes separately on the left. Let the model see both.
